per_hop.query:
SELECT host_name, COUNT(*) AS total_shows_hosted
FROM tv_show_hosts
WHERE show_name IN (
  SELECT show_name
  FROM tv_appearances
  WHERE performer_name = 'Paul Melba'
    AND country = 'United Kingdom'
)
GROUP BY host_name
HAVING COUNT(*) = 23;
